MemberSignature.Value: .field public static literal valuetype Android.Telecom.ConnectionCapability AddParticipant = int32(67108864)
AddParticipant = 67108864

summary.para: When set, indicates that this Connection supports initiation of a conference call by directly adding participants using onAddConferenceParticipants(List). When participants are added to a Connection, it will be replaced by a Conference instance with PROPERTY_IS_ADHOC_CONFERENCE set to indicate that it is an adhoc conference call.

MemberSignature.Value: .field public static literal valuetype Android.Telecom.ConnectionCapability CannotDowngradeVideoToAudio = int32(8388608)
CannotDowngradeVideoToAudio = 8388608

summary.para: When set, prevents a video call from being downgraded to an audio-only call.

Should be set when the VideoState has the VideoProfile.STATE_TX_ENABLED or VideoProfile.STATE_RX_ENABLED bits set to indicate that the connection cannot be downgraded from a video call back to a VideoState of VideoProfile.STATE_AUDIO_ONLY.

Intuitively, a call which can be downgraded to audio should also have local and remote video capabilities (see CAPABILITY_SUPPORTS_VT_LOCAL_BIDIRECTIONAL and CAPABILITY_SUPPORTS_VT_REMOTE_BIDIRECTIONAL).

MemberSignature.Value: .field public static literal valuetype Android.Telecom.ConnectionCapability Hold = int32(1)
Hold = 1

summary.para: Connection can currently be put on hold or unheld. This is distinct from CAPABILITY_SUPPORT_HOLD in that although a connection may support 'hold' most times, it does not at the moment support the function. This can be true while the call is in the state STATE_DIALING, for example. During this condition, an in-call UI may display a disabled 'hold' button.

MemberSignature.Value: .field public static literal valuetype Android.Telecom.ConnectionCapability MergeConference = int32(4)
MergeConference = 4

summary.para: Connections within a conference can be merged. A ConnectionService has the option to add a Conference before the child Connections are merged. This is how CDMA-based Connections are implemented. For these unmerged Conferences, this capability allows a merge button to be shown while the conference is in the foreground of the in-call UI.
This is only intended for use by a Conference.
